title: Block Billing Actions for Containers on Hold
summary: Prevent billing-related actions, including payor record updates and financial processing, for bookings currently in HOLD status.
requirements: The edit booking endpoint (`PUT /api/bookings/:id`) must reject changes to payor fields when the booking is in HOLD status, returning a 403 response with a clear reason
The cutoff logic in `checkCutoff` inside `server/src/routes/bookings.ts` must be extended to include HOLD status as an additional blocking condition for payor edits
A new helper `isOnHold(booking)` should be introduced alongside the existing cutoff helpers
The `BookingFormPage` in the frontend must display a hold-lock message when the booking is in HOLD, similar to the existing cutoff-lock behaviour
The booking detail page must show a "Billing blocked — container on hold" notice
acceptanceCriteria: PUT /api/bookings/:id returns 403 with reason "Booking is on hold" when billing fields are changed
Active bookings not in HOLD behave exactly as before
Frontend shows the hold-lock message on the booking form when status is HOLD
references: CG-101 (requires the HOLD status introduced by CG-101)
